version: 2 (re-committed after D-68 amendment 2; version 1 at 9db5e22; its partial run was discarded)
label: DEVELOPMENT, block H (exposed, D-53); attack design on exposed H, POST HOC (D-68 as amended); committed before any stealth run on block H
decisions: D-68 + amendment 1 (exact projection) + amendment 2 (infeasible = not applied)
unchanged_from_D-65: objectives (pgd_untargeted_stealth uses pgd_untargeted's, pgd_remove_stealth uses pgd_remove's), 10 steps, step eps_k / 4, random start U(-eps_k, eps_k), sign-gradient ascent, final iterate, no-GT pseudo-labels from the clean fused output

stealth_projection.when: after the random start and after every PGD step, per scale k
stealth_projection.box: lo = max(-eps_k, -f_k), hi = eps_k (f + delta >= 0 everywhere)
stealth_projection.projection: exact Euclidean projection onto box and constraint: delta_k <- clip(delta_k - lambda_k, lo, hi); lambda_k = 0 if the constraint holds, else the smallest lambda_k >= 0 satisfying it, bisection on [0, max(delta_k - lo)] to tolerance 1e-7 x bracket; sums in float64

infeasible_frames (D-68 amendment 2).check: before PGD on a frame, per scale from the clean features: feasible iff mean(f_k + lo_k) <= 0.95 tau_k mean|f_receiver,k| (lo_k = max(-eps_k, -f_k)); pgd_stealth.feasibility, same float64 arithmetic as the projection
infeasible_frames (D-68 amendment 2).rule: any scale infeasible -> the stealth attack is NOT applied on that frame: scored as clean (E0-E5 convention for attacks that cannot be placed); ledger reason 'stealth_infeasible'
infeasible_frames (D-68 amendment 2).reported: per family, per r and per scenario: infeasible, applied, realized counts; attack loss AP@0.7 all-frame and realized-only, both AP definitions (v3_analyze.pgd_by_scenario)
infeasible_frames (D-68 amendment 2).clean_feature_count_H: 13/371 at r = 0.25, 1/371 at r = 0.5, 0 at r = 1.0, all at scale 3 (stealth_feasibility_by_r.json)
infeasible_frames (D-68 amendment 2).test: same rule unchanged; infeasible counts are a pre-registered reported quantity

selection_rule_for_test: unchanged: per family, the smallest r with all-frame global-ranking AP@0.7 attack loss >= 0.02 on block H (infeasible frames scored as clean); if none, 'too weak under stealth' and r = 1.0 on test
stop: stealth attack loss < 0.005 at r = 1.0 (global AP) for a family -> 'stealth PGD ineffective on this model', stop and ask before v3; any frozen method file would need to change

expected_outcomes_stated_before_run.B-NORM: catch rate <= 5% (about the clean false-flag rate, 1.6%)

run.conditions: clean, 5 E4 families, D-67 option-1 families at r = 0.25, stealth families at every r
run.also: realized-only (pgd_remove rule for *_remove_stealth, pgd_untargeted rule for *_untargeted_stealth), B-NORM catch rate and per-scale ratios, attack loss per r
